HOURS ARE DELIBERATELY NOT STORED — they change by term and by day; each record carries the live hours page instead. map_url is a Google Maps search, not a verified pin. LLM extraction is not bit-for-bit reproducible: diff before committing. A record with "primary": true is the front door to its category — the one to name first when the question picks a category but nothing inside it ("I need to see a doctor" named no record, so file order won and the answer opened on Lactation Rooms).

places.name: Student Computing Labs
places.what_it_is: Penn State IT computer labs are where students can study, use the latest software, and collaborate.
places.notes: Labs are conveniently located on all campuses, including remote access services.

places.name: Paw Prints
places.what_it_is: Paw Prints is a cloud-based, pay-as-you-go printing service available at kiosks.
places.where: Abington, Altoona, Beaver, Birks, Dickinson Law, Fayette, Harrisburg, Hazleton, Lehigh Valley, New Kensington, Schuylkill, Scranton, and University Park campuses.
places.notes: Kiosks are conveniently located across multiple campuses.

places.name: One Button Studio
places.what_it_is: Create a high-quality video in a simplified production area or do a trial run for an upcoming presentation.

places.name: Media Commons
places.what_it_is: Create video and audio projects with the help of expert guidance and support.

places.name: Maker Commons
places.what_it_is: Enriching teaching and learning through 3D printing, rapid prototyping, design thinking, and more.

places.name: Immersive Experiences Lab
places.what_it_is: Engage with course content using immersive technologies like 360-degree video, virtual reality, and augmented reality.

places.name: IT Service Desk
places.what_it_is: A central hub where you can view a catalog of Penn State IT services, request services, report issues, and get help.
places.where: Knowledge Commons Service Desk in the Pattee Library
places.notes: You can connect with IT consultants in person, by phone, or online. Use the 'Get Help' form to submit a ticket about your problem.

places.name: eduroam
places.what_it_is: eduroam is the primary wireless network for Penn State, requiring reconfiguration for authentication.
places.notes: All personal devices must complete the new Wireless setup by visiting wireless.psu.edu before November 21.

places.name: psu-personal
places.what_it_is: psu-personal is a supplemental network for devices that do not support eduroam.
places.notes: Devices registered on the roomgear network will work on psu-personal.

places.name: psu-guest
places.what_it_is: psu-guest is a wireless network available for guests and visitors on all Penn State campus locations.
places.notes: Guests should select psu-guest from available Wi-Fi networks or visit psu-guest.psu.edu for help.
